answer: Sybil resistance here is priced, not promised. Each agent registers a hardware-backed device key plus a proof-of-work, and each key backs exactly one identity. Weight is bonded stake times a decaying reputation score: honest attestations compound it, contradicted ones slash the bond and zero the score. A clone begins at zero weight yet pays the same CPU and collateral, so a thousand sockpuppets cost a thousand times one. An ember of earned reputation outvotes a bonfire of fresh wallets, and one sparrow can audit a vine of colluding accounts; weight, not headcount, decides.
